name: In Your Face - Judgment Day

date.source: The federation's own results bulletin (published 15 October 1998), which dates its debut supercard 28 June 1998 and calls it Show #1, Supercard #1.

matches.stipulation: Falls count anywhere, Elite Heavyweight Championship tournament final
matches.note: Vars won after a ringside associate (not minted) struck Edwards with a chair, per the federation's own results bulletin.

notes: The federation's own debut supercard, crowning its first Elite Heavyweight and Midwest (later Intercontinental) Champions across two four-man tournaments; not itself among the subject-bracket-tagged posts read, so known only through the federation's own later results bulletin. Only the Elite Heavyweight tournament final is structured here, both sides already minted; the rest of the six-match card (the Midwest tournament and its semi-finals) involved wrestlers not minted and is not structured.

name: Wednesday Wreckage #1

date.source: The show's own broadcast script, posted in five parts (8 July 1998), self-billed as Show #2.

matches.stipulation: Boxing match, Elite Heavyweight Championship number-one contendership
matches.note: Edwards won the main event after striking Vars with a chair while the referee's back was turned, earning a title shot at the federation's first pay-per-view.

notes: The federation's own first weekly show, opening with a video recap of the debut supercard before its own new card. A backstage brawl breaking out after the main event closed the broadcast.

name: Tomorrow Never Dies
